SHYGON · VERSION 01

AAROH

One card, three editions: Signature Noir, Ivory Atelier and Midnight Titanium. A lotus emblem, Indian architecture and botany in relief, foil you can feel.

Concept renders drawn from the specification (vector, with lighting filters), not photographs. The AAROH lotus emblem is a proposal awaiting approval. PROPOSED — REQUIRES VALIDATION.

Material and finish comparison

All PROPOSED — REQUIRES VALIDATION with the selected supplier.

Signature NoirIvory AtelierMidnight Titanium
SubstrateBlack-core PVC or PETG composite; printed black overlay (PROPOSED)White-core PVC or PETG composite, warm ivory print (PROPOSED)PVC or PETG composite with a brushed-effect print layer (PROPOSED)
Surface finishSoft-touch matte overlay with a fine grainSatin overlay with a fine toothSatin overlay; brushed texture printed or embossed
Relief processTonal emboss or tactile varnish of the ogee lattice, 0.03–0.08 mmBlind emboss of the botanical garland, 0.05–0.10 mm; AAROH debossedLaser-etched or tactile varnish flow lines, 0.02–0.05 mm
Metallic accentChampagne-gold hot foil: emblem, AAROH, byline, temple skyline and a 0.55 mm borderChampagne-gold hot foil: emblem, byline, rule and a 0.70 mm borderPlatinum-silver foil: emblem, AAROH, byline, every third flow line and a 0.55 mm border
EdgeBlack core; optional gold edge paint (durability test required)Ivory core; optional gold edge paintDark blue or graphite core; optional silver edge paint
NFC riskMedium. The foil border must not form a closed metal loop around the antenna: break it (a gap of at least 1 mm) or print it in non-conductive metallic inkMedium. The foil border must not form a closed metal loop around the antenna: break it (a gap of at least 1 mm) or print it in non-conductive metallic inkHIGHER. Any conductive metallised layer can detune the antenna; use non-conductive metallic ink for the brushed effect. The foil border must not form a closed metal loop around the antenna: break it (a gap of at least 1 mm) or print it in non-conductive metallic ink
Relative costMediumMedium to high (emboss tooling)Medium to high
